listing.name: Nes's SAW
listing.aiSummary: Adds ships with cosmetic skins, custom paintjobs, exploration content, and a main menu mission.

description:
Nes's SAW
Ships with cosmetic Skins. Splendid!

Includes:
-a handful of lovingly crafted ships, a weapon, as well as few portraits
-custom paintjobs for ships, access them in the refit screen
-exploration content to discover while traveling across the sector
-main menu mission to get acquainted with some of the new content

Download:
Patreon

Requires LazyLib
Requires MagicLib

Nes's SAW can be safely added to an existing save.
To install, simply download the .zip file from the link above, unzip it in your Starsector mods directory, and enable it in the launcher.

To update a mod, first remove the old folder, then move in the new, updated one.
Merging or replacing a folder without removing the old one is one of the most common causes of crashes!


New ships:




New paintjobs for the vanilla ships:


And more!


Portraits:


Player-exclusive portraits are only available during character creation and will not otherwise appear ingame.


Weapons:

Laevatein Assault Cannon

Large Ballistic
- triple barreled, rotary configuration of the venerable Mjolnir
-fires the same devastating round, in a prolonged burst
-more flux efficient, if all shots land
-high upfront flux cost per salvo
-less overall dps
-barrels go speeen~

Spoiler
Hellbore alternative look

Essentially a visual update for the vanilla hellbore

If you prefer vanilla looks simply remove hellbore_ sprites located in graphics/weapons from the mod folder.

Credits:
Art, Implementation, and Bad Ideas: Nes
Special Thanks: Nia, DR, Luzaitis, and many other Unofficial Starsector Discord fine folks
Additional Thanks: Trylobot and Deathfly for the invaluable ship and weapon editor, LazyLib and MagicLib for making life easier, Fractal Softworks team for creating an excellent game and finally you, the player
